Pour exploiter les services, des prestataires technologiques d’infrastructure et d’analytique, dont Microsoft, peuvent traiter les informations pour le compte de LCE selon les accords et conditions applicables ; selon le service, une partie du traitement technique peut avoir lieu hors du Mexique.

Os dados enviados pelo formulário de diagnóstico são armazenados no Azure Table Storage com controles de acesso às tabelas da LCE por identidade gerenciada. LCE aplica medidas administrativas y téc: LCE applies administrative and technical measures proportionate to the nature of the information to restrict unauthorized access and protect its confidentiality and integrity. Information will be retained as long as necessary to handle requests, fulfill legal or contractual obligations and manage claims; it will then be deleted or blocked when legally appropriate. The organization will review its internal retention periods according to the type of record.

L’organisation réexaminera ses durées internes de conservation selon le type de dossier.
